## Access the diagnostic columns

Run `farmSetup` from the repository root first. This small example samples every location in an array and requests a mean and finite-value count. The diagnostic columns are returned alongside those requested statistics.

```matlab
signal = [0 NaN 2; Inf 4 -Inf];
results = farmQueryField(signal, true(size(signal)), {'Mean', 'Count'}, ...
    struct('FieldName', 'Signal'));
results.Signal_Mean           % 2
results.Signal_Count          % 3 finite values
results.Signal_SelectedCount  % 6 selected locations
results.Signal_FiniteCount    % 3
```

`farmQueryField` uses `<FieldName>_<quantity>` column names. `farmQueryFrame` uses the query name as the prefix. Vector components use `<FieldName>_<ComponentName>_<quantity>`. No population or ancestry reduction is implied.

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-selectedcount"></a>

## SelectedCount

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[double scalar per row; table column across rows]

The number of selected voxel locations actually sampled after support preparation, including any applied centroid fallback. Indices are deduplicated within the resulting support group.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("SelectedCount", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Produced by farmQueryField; retained separately for each component by queryVectorField. Includes samples that become NaN or infinite. SelectedCount equals FiniteCount+NaNCount+PositiveInfCount+NegativeInfCount. A sample operation must return one value per selected location.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_SelectedCount;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES-MOCKUP.md?plain=1#L432)

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-finitecount"></a>

## FiniteCount

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[double scalar per row; table column across rows]

The number of sampled values that are neither NaN nor positive or negative infinity. Built-in scalar statistics use these finite values only.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("FiniteCount", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Produced by farmQueryField; independent per component in queryVectorField. FiniteCount can be zero while SelectedCount is nonzero. The requested Count statistic equals FiniteCount, not SelectedCount.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_FiniteCount;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-selectionempty"></a>

## SelectionEmpty

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[logical scalar per row; table column across rows]

True when the final selected index list is empty, after support preparation and any centroid fallback.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("SelectionEmpty", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Produced by queryField. An empty skeleton with an applied centroid fallback can have SelectionEmpty = false and GeometryEmpty = true. A nonempty selection containing only nonfinite values has SelectionEmpty = false but FiniteCount = 0.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_SelectionEmpty;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES-MOCKUP.md?plain=1#L457)

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-geometryempty"></a>

## GeometryEmpty

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[logical scalar per support record or result row]

True when the source generated geometry has no computed indices. When generated components are combined by parent ID, true means every source component had empty geometry before fallback.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("GeometryEmpty", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Set by farmPrepareSupport for generated-geometry records and copied into farmQueryField results. Does not become false merely because fallback adds a centroid. For raw selections and prepared memberships this provenance flag defaults to false; an empty raw mask is instead indicated by SelectionEmpty. Some empty components do not make an otherwise nonempty combined geometry empty; inspect EmptyGeometryCount for that case.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_GeometryEmpty;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES-MOCKUP.md?plain=1#L462)

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-emptygeometrycount"></a>

## EmptyGeometryCount

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[double scalar per support record or result row]

The number of source generated-geometry records whose computed index lists were empty before fallback.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("EmptyGeometryCount", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Set by farmPrepareSupport and copied into farmQueryField results. With component results this is zero or one; with components combined by parent ID it is the sum over source records. Raw selections and prepared memberships default to zero.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_EmptyGeometryCount;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-usedfallback"></a>

## UsedFallback

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[logical scalar per support record or result row]

True when support preparation substitutes a rounded, nearest-voxel centroid for an empty generated skeleton record, or any constituent record uses that substitution when combined by parent ID.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("UsedFallback", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Set by farmPrepareSupport and copied into farmQueryField results. Currently controlled by CentroidFallback; it does not describe every fallback mechanism in the package, such as the single-voxel ProjectedExtent fallback. SelectionEmpty can be false even though GeometryEmpty remains true.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_UsedFallback;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES-MOCKUP.md?plain=1#L472)

<a id="datadictionary-sampling-diagnostics-fallbackcount"></a>

## FallbackCount

**DataDictionary / Sampling diagnostics**

[double scalar per support record or result row]

The number of source skeleton records for which centroid fallback was applied during support preparation.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: {''}
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("FallbackCount", "Section", "DataDictionary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Set by farmPrepareSupport and copied into farmQueryField results. With component results this is zero or one; with components combined by parent ID it is summed. It counts substituted records, not unique fallback voxels: overlapping centroid locations may be deduplicated in the final selection.


</details>

<details>
<summary>Access in returned data</summary>


After a scalar query with `FieldName = 'Signal'`:

```matlab
value = results.Signal_FallbackCount;
```

For query/component prefixes, see the example at the top of this page. These are generated values, not additional inputs.


</details>
